about: v4 motion.wide_pose sampled at 240 Hz of the kickflip source clock (wide shot D, 5.155-15.415 s). Screen-space reconstruction through an assumed lens: not a measured trajectory, height, speed or angle. Roll is one turn to the left about the long axis; plumes follow the observed windows.
matrix_layout: column-major 3x4: X axis, Y axis, Z axis, origin (car-local to world)
cloud_rule: r = min(rmax, r0 + grow * (t - born)); centre = (x, y, max(zc, 0.45 r)); density = density * min(1, 0.4 + (t - born)); vertical flattening = flatten
